subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Maya Lin (born 1959) is an American architect and sculptor.
• She is the daughter of Chinese immigrants.
• She won the Pritzker Architecture Prize in 2004.
• The National Gallery of Art in Washington, D.C., owns a sculpture that Lin created from black granite.
• The sculpture features smooth, flowing curves and rises in a wave-like formation from the gallery floor.
prompt: The student wants to describe the sculpture to an audience unfamiliar with Maya Lin. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: With its smooth, flowing curves and wave-like formation, the black granite sculpture in Washington's National Gallery of Art is just one piece created by American architect and sculptor Maya Lin.
choices.B: Maya Lin was born in 1959 and is still active today, and during her career, she made a sculpture that you can see if you visit the National Gallery of Art in Washington.
choices.C: Architect and sculptor Maya Lin was a recipient of the prestigious Pritzker Architecture Prize in 2004.
choices.D: The sculpture is made from black granite, and it has been shaped such that it features smooth, flowing curves and rises in a wave-like formation.

explanation:
Choice A is the best answer. The sentence effectively describes the sculpture to an audience unfamiliar with Maya Lin, noting its smooth, flowing curves and wave-like formation and explaining that Maya Lin (the granite sculpture's creator) was an American architect and sculptor.

Why C is incorrect:

Choice C is incorrect. While the sentence explains who Maya Lin was, it doesn't describe the sculpture.
